question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An edged, bladed weapon that is longer than a knife
solution:
The correct answer is '**Sword**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Sword**'.
 
• It means 'a long, very sharp metal weapon, like a large knife'. (तलवार, कटार)
 
 
• *Example: Armed only with a short **sword**, he drove off all five of his attackers.*
